Code arrives from DoNotReply@ddec.pr.gov. If no code arrives, stop — never invent or reuse a code. QA-mode OTP assist is a runner feature for test businesses, not part of this skill. Exact heading not recorded — confirm on the next walk.

label.es: Crear una solicitud de Permiso Único

rules: POST-LOGIN SWEEP: the first screen after login/MFA is a NEW step, never a continuation of login. If it asks profile, identity or project questions, fill every non-sensitive blank from the passport first, then ask the rest in chat. Never skip a question batch because login had none.
Fill every mapped field from the passport before pausing for anything the passport cannot supply.

actions.rule: CUSTOM DROPDOWNS: SBP dropdowns are not native <select>. Click the control to open the list, then click the option. Read the shown value back; if it still shows the placeholder, open it and click once more.
If 'Permiso Único' is not in the list, stop and report what the list shows.

steps.note: From OGPe's official Permiso Único manual. If the wizard asks whether to attach an existing project or create one, ask the human.

label.en: Who the project is filed under
label.es: A nombre de quién sale el proyecto

page_match.title_contains: ¿A nombre de quién deben salir los trámites

actions.rule: Always choose 'Usted'; never 'De una compañía'. The Compañías selector is empty on new accounts and Clara never invents a company. If the filing must be in the company's name, the human picks it in the browser.

steps.note: Observed in the 2026-09-28 live QA run (options: Usted / De otra persona / De una compañía).

ask.en: What do you want to call this project? For example, the store's name and town.
ask.es: ¿Qué nombre le quieres poner a este proyecto? Por ejemplo, el nombre del local y el pueblo.

fields.rule: CUSTOM DROPDOWNS: open the list, click the option whose visible text matches the passport entity type, read it back. Never pick an option that isn't listed — ask instead.
The portal rejects PO boxes and unverifiable addresses — report its message instead of retrying.
CUSTOM DROPDOWNS: open the list, click the matching municipio, read it back.

gates.note: User signs in with their own portal account.

handoff.en: Sign in to the Single Business Portal yourself in the browser. SmartPR never sees or types your password.
handoff.es: Entra tú al Single Business Portal en el navegador. SmartPR nunca ve ni escribe tu contraseña.

handoff.en: OGPe just emailed you a code from DoNotReply@ddec.pr.gov. Type it into the portal, then tell me to continue.
handoff.es: OGPe te acaba de enviar un código por email desde DoNotReply@ddec.pr.gov. Escríbelo en el portal y me dices para seguir.

handoff.en: The portal is showing a CAPTCHA. Solve it yourself, then tell me to continue.
handoff.es: El portal está pidiendo un CAPTCHA. Resuélvelo tú y me dices para seguir.

gates.note: Parcel/catastro needs verified data — confirm before continuing.

handoff.en: OGPe needs your property's parcel (Número de Catastro). The easiest way is to find your property on the map — that fills the fields for you. Pick it, then tell me to continue.
handoff.es: OGPe necesita la parcela de tu propiedad (Número de Catastro). Lo más fácil es buscarla en el mapa — eso llena los campos solo. Escógela y me dices para seguir.

gates.note: Uploads come in through the chat (INLINE channel).

handoff.en: OGPe needs your supporting documents (site plan, photo ID, entity certificates — max 5 MB each). Upload them here in the chat.
handoff.es: OGPe necesita tus documentos de apoyo (plano del local, ID con foto, certificados de la entidad — máx. 5 MB c/u). Súbelos aquí en el chat.

gates.note: Attestation under penalty of perjury — Clara never checks this.

handoff.en: This is the "Bajo juramento" certification — a legal statement only you can make. Read it and check it yourself.
handoff.es: Esta es la certificación "Bajo juramento" — una declaración legal que solo tú puedes hacer. Léela y márcala tú.

gates.note: Including a typed name used as a signature.

handoff.en: The portal is asking for your signature. Only you can sign.
handoff.es: El portal está pidiendo tu firma. Solo tú puedes firmar.

handoff.en: Time to pay OGPe. Check the amount and pay in the portal yourself. The payment is non-refundable.
handoff.es: Te toca pagarle a OGPe. Verifica el monto y paga tú en el portal. El pago no es reembolsable.

gates.note: Final radicar — always human, after review.

handoff.en: Everything is filled in. Review every screen, and when you're sure, press Radicar yourself. Nothing is filed until you do.
handoff.es: Ya está todo lleno. Revisa cada pantalla y, cuando estés seguro, dale tú a Radicar. No se radica nada hasta que tú lo hagas.
